issues.description: The problem statement and template expect an instance method addRating(stars:) on Course that students can call (declared in an extension). In the solution the method is declared as private (private func addRating(stars: Int)), which would prevent code in other files (e.g., Client.swift) from calling it. This is a visibility mismatch: the template and problem imply a non-private instance method, but the solution makes it private, which would break the intended usage from outside the file.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the addRating(stars:) method non-private so it can be called from other files/modules as intended. For example, remove the 'private' modifier (use the default internal visibility) or mark it 'public' if it should be exposed outside the module. Ensure the template, problem description, and solution use the same visibility level.
